Account summary: building an opinionated IDE copilot targeted at enterprise engineering teams. Key differentiator: safe function/tool calling that can run tests, linters and mini-builds inside a sandboxed runner. Very focused on low tail-latency for developer feedback loops (target <50ms token stream for completions), and deterministic model/version pinning for reproducible code actions.

Customer constraints & asks:
- Must support sandboxed execution (isolated containers, ephemeral VMs) with strict egress controls. Prefers on-prem or VPC with customer-controlled KMS.
- Requires audit logs for every tool invocation, retention policy 7 years for compliance auditing.
- Needs function-calling primitives that can surface structured test results and streaming build logs back into the editor.
- Cost sensitivity: wants guidance on batching vs single-token latency; willing to commit to reserved capacity if ROI for dev velocity is proven.
